correctness.rationale: For every n>=1, multiplying any pair (i,j), i<j, by diagonal (k,k) forces all intervening (i,k), and similarly (k,i) for reversed pairs. Conversely, products of two upper pairs, two lower pairs and a mixed upper/lower pair preserve independently selected upper/lower initial prefixes; hence all 2(n-1) reach digits range independently over 0..n-1-i. Relation inclusion is digitwise and yields product_(r=2..n)([r]x[r]), (n!)^2 cardinality and squared Mahonian rank polynomial. Compatible equivalences have interval classes; all interval partitions arise as kernels of nondecreasing min-homomorphisms, giving 2^(n-1) and Stirling asymptotic. The n=1 case gives singleton. Independent n=4 brute force gave 576 relations, eight congruences and the exact palindromic rank distribution; finite test corroborates unrestricted symbolic proof.
